blueprintStages.name: Validate

blueprintStages.name: Identify gaps

blueprintStages.name: Verify

blueprintStages.name: Publish

blueprintStages.name: Discover
blueprintStages.detail: Identify primary job aggregation platforms, company career pages, and niche tech job boards operating in India. Focus on sources with robust API access or structured scraping capabilities. Prioritize platforms with high Java backend developer traffic such as LinkedIn Jobs, Indeed India, Naukri.com, AngelList, and company career pages of major Indian IT firms (TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCL, etc.).

blueprintStages.name: Collect
blueprintStages.detail: Systematically crawl or query identified sources for Java backend developer listings posted within the last 30 days. Implement rate-limiting and respect robots.txt. For API-based sources, use pagination to retrieve all relevant records. For static pages, use headless browsers to render JavaScript content.

blueprintStages.name: Extract
blueprintStages.detail: Parse job listings to extract required fields (Company, Role, Location, Experience, Salary) and optional fields. Handle dynamic content and nested structures. Normalize role titles to standardize variations (e.g., 'Java Backend Developer' vs 'Backend Engineer - Java').

blueprintStages.name: Clean
blueprintStages.detail: Standardize extracted values: convert location formats (e.g., 'Bangalore' to 'Bengaluru'), normalize experience ranges (e.g., '3-5 years' to 36-60 months), and clean salary data (remove currency symbols, standardize units like LPA/year). Handle missing or malformed data gracefully.

blueprintStages.name: Deduplicate
blueprintStages.detail: Merge duplicate listings across sources using fuzzy matching on company, role, and location. Prioritize sources with higher confidence ratings (e.g., company career pages over aggregators). Flag records with conflicting data for verification.

blueprintStages.name: Validate
blueprintStages.detail: Verify source provenance and evidence for each record. Cross-check company names against official databases (e.g., MCA registry for Indian companies). Validate posting dates and ensure they fall within the 30-day window. Assign confidence scores based on source reliability.

blueprintStages.name: Identify gaps
blueprintStages.detail: Flag records missing critical fields (Company, Role, Location, Experience) or with conflicting values. Prioritize gaps based on their impact on data usability (e.g., missing salary is less critical than missing company).

blueprintStages.name: Verify
blueprintStages.detail: Targeted verification for high-priority gaps or conflicts. Re-scrape sources for missing data where possible. Contact companies directly for salary ranges or role clarifications if necessary. Update confidence scores based on verification results.

blueprintStages.name: Publish
blueprintStages.detail: Generate final structured dataset with audit trail. Include confidence ratings for each record and field. Provide source citations for all values. Export in JSON/CSV format with metadata describing collection methodology, sources, and quality metrics.
